findings.impact: A registry change renaming a domain would not be caught by the test suite. The error message format that clients parse to discover valid domain names is unverified.
findings.mitigation: Add test_consult_rules_returns_unsupported_domain_error: ConsultRulesRequest(domain='banana-domain'). Assert isinstance(response, ErrorResponse), response.error_code == 'SCP-MCP-E021', 'expected one of' in response.message.

findings.claim: test_resolve_domain.py still has no test for the confidence=0.0 / empty-domains case; the boundary that determines whether the 021F pre-commit hook fires is unverified.
findings.evidence: test_resolve_domain.py — 2 tests: exact-match (confidence=1.0) and fuzzy-frontend (0.0 < confidence < 1.0). No test for a path matching neither registry entries nor fuzzy heuristics (e.g., 'random/binary/artifact.bin'). tools.py:740-746 — confidence defaults to 0.0 when neither saw_exact nor saw_fuzzy. Not closed in fix-round-2. Carry-forward from R2 COMP-PERSIST-003.
findings.impact: Per WP-SCP-021 §4 021F failure mode (b), a non-empty resolve_domain result triggers the consult-receipt requirement. An undetected regression producing spurious domain matches for unknown paths would incorrectly require receipts; failing to produce domains for known paths would allow the consult gate to be skipped.

findings.claim: audit_changed_impl still passes original symbolic ref strings (base_ref, head_ref) to _list_changed_files_with_timeout and _run_audit_changed_cli after resolving those refs to SHAs for the cache key; a TOCTOU window remains between SHA resolution and diff execution.
findings.evidence: tools.py:795-799 — _list_changed_files_with_timeout(base_ref=base_ref, head_ref=head_ref, ...) uses original symbolic refs. tools.py:815-819 — _run_audit_changed_cli(base_ref=base_ref, head_ref=head_ref, ...) also uses original symbolic refs. Cache key at tools.py:783 correctly uses resolved_base_ref and resolved_head_ref. If HEAD advances between SHA resolution (line 768) and diff execution (line 795), the diff runs on a different object than the cache key records. test_audit_changed.py:10-51 monkeypatches both functions so does not verify which ref string they receive. Not closed in fix-round-2. Carry-forward from R2 COR-R2-003.
findings.impact: Cache entry is stored under the pre-call SHA but reflects the post-call HEAD diff. Benign in current 021C stdio; becomes a correctness regression when 021E commits to proposal branches or 021H enables concurrent calls.
findings.mitigation: Pass resolved_base_ref and resolved_head_ref to _list_changed_files_with_timeout and _run_audit_changed_cli. Update _run_audit_changed_cli to forward resolved SHAs as --base-ref and --head-ref CLI arguments.

findings.claim: server.py instructions field is stale scaffold text from 021B; it states tools are introduced in later slices when seven are now registered.
findings.evidence: server.py:44-48 — instructions='Standards Control Plane MCP scaffold. Tools and resources are introduced in later implementation slices.' tools.py:971-980 — register_tools() registers consult_rules, check_waiver, list_open_decisions, check_finding, audit_changed, resolve_domain, propose. Not updated in fix-round-2. Carry-forward from R2 COMP-PERSIST-004.
findings.impact: MCP clients that surface server instructions to agents may mislead them into skipping tool discovery.
findings.mitigation: Update instructions to: 'Standards Control Plane MCP server (v{__version__}). Tools: consult_rules, check_waiver, list_open_decisions, check_finding, audit_changed, resolve_domain, propose. Resources introduced in slice 021D.'

findings.claim: list_open_decisions_impl has no docstring documenting that it returns all decision rows regardless of status column value; tool name implies open-only semantics.
findings.evidence: tools.py:686-700 — list_open_decisions_impl filters only by the since date; no filter on decision.status. DECISIONS.md table carries a status column with values ACCEPTED and SUPERSEDED. No docstring added in fix-round-2. Carry-forward from R2 COMP-PERSIST-005.
findings.impact: Consumers relying on the tool name semantics receive superseded decisions alongside active ones with no programmatic way to distinguish them.
findings.mitigation: Add one-line docstring: 'Returns all decision rows regardless of status; use the since parameter to limit by date.'

structured_review.summary: All five R2 MAJ findings are closed and verified by new tests. No new CRIT or MAJ completeness issues found on fresh pass. Seven MIN/nit carry-forwards remain open (unchanged from R2 grade); none of the surviving MINs escalate to MAJ under current 021C scope. Verdict meets the WP-SCP-022 §4.3 fixpoint criterion: APPROVED_WITH_FINDINGS with MIN/nit-only residual.
